How the score works

            
Every home is scored 0 to 100 on four groups, then combined using the weights you set on the left. Lifestyle fit is itself an average of schedule overlap, noise, guests, and habits, because that is where most flatmate arrangements actually break down.

            

              

                
Budget

                
Full marks well under your cap, sliding down as rent crosses it. Move-in cost counts the deposit, which in Bengaluru flats is often 4 to 6 months of rent.

              

              

                
Commute

                
Typical peak-hour drive times from each area to your office hub. Hybrid softens the penalty; full WFH mostly ignores it.

              

              

                
Food

                
Your diet against the home's kitchen: veg-only, non-veg cooked at home, or both. Plus whether meals are included when you want them.

              

              

                
Lifestyle fit

                
Sleep and shift overlap with the people already there, noise level, how often guests stay over, and smoking and drinking norms.

Use the requirement post above in real flatmate groups, and verify any real home in person before paying anything.
